events.title: The merger between Flerie and Biosergen has been completed
events.text: THIS ANNOUNCEMENT SHOULD NOT BE DISTRIBUTED, WHETHER DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY, IN OR INTO AUSTRALIA, CANADA, JAPAN, NEW ZEALAND, SOUTH AFRICA OR THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA. THIS ANNOUNCEMENT SHOULD ALSO NOT BE DISTRIBUTED IN OR INTO ANY OTHER JURISDICTION WHERE SUCH DISTRIBUTION REQUIRES ANY OTHER DOCUMENTATION, REGISTRATION, OR MEASURES BEYOND WHAT IS GOVERNED BY SWEDISH LAW. The Swedish Companies Registration Office (Sw. Bolagsverket) has today registered the merger between Flerie AB (publ) (”Flerie”) and Biosergen AB (”Biosergen”). The merger between Flerie and Biosergen is thus completed. With the registration, the merger has obtained final legal effect, and all assets and liabilities of Biosergen have been transferred to Flerie. The merged company retains the name Flerie AB (publ) and will continue to be headquartered in Stockholm. In connection with the registration, Biosergen’s operations have been transferred to a new subsidiary of Flerie’s wholly-owned subsidiary, Flerie Invest AB. In conjunction with the registration of the merger, the Swedish Companies Registration Office has today registered the issuance of 2,667,234 new ordinary shares in Flerie as merger consideration. As a result of the issue, Flerie’s share capital has increased by SEK 5,867,914.80. Consequently, Flerie now has a total share capital of SEK 196,602,859.20, divided into 89,364,936 shares, all of which are ordinary shares. The shareholders listed in Biosergen’s share ledger as of the record date 26 October 2026 will receive merger consideration. For every thirty-one (31) shares held in Biosergen, shareholders will receive one (1) newly issued ordinary share in Flerie. No actions will be required from Biosergen’s shareholders in order to receive the merger consideration. Biosergen’s shareholders are expected to receive these new shares, i.e. the merger consideration, on or about 28 October 2026. Trading in Flerie’s shares will continue as usual and will not be affected by the merger process. For more information, please contact: Ted Fjällman, CEO of Flerie E-mail: ir@flerie.com Telephone: +46 (0)76 600 89 26 About Flerie Flerie is an active long-term life science investor, with a broad and diversified portfolio of innovative companies based on pioneering science. We invest in product development and commercial growth opportunities globally alongside other leading investors, focusing predominantly on private companies that are otherwise difficult to access. Flerie’s active ownership model, broad network and resources support and accelerate the development of the portfolio projects, creating value for shareholders. Flerie AB’s ordinary share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm with the ticker FLERIE. For further information please visit www.flerie.com (http://www.flerie.com/). This press release is not a notice to attend an extraordinary general meeting or a merger document. Bolagsverket har idag registrerat sammanslagningen mellan Flerie AB (publ) (”Flerie”) och Biosergen AB (”Biosergen”). Fusionen mellan Flerie och Biosergen är därmed slutförd. Fusionen har genom registreringen fått slutlig rättsverkan och Biosergens samtliga tillgångar och skulder har övergått till Flerie. Det sammanslagna bolaget behåller namnet Flerie AB (publ) och har även fortsättningsvis sitt säte i Stockholm. Biosergens verksamhet har i samband med registreringen tillskjutits ett nytt dotterbolag till Fleries helägda dotterbolag Flerie Invest AB. I samband med registreringen av sammanslagningen har Bolagsverket idag registrerat emissionen av 2 667 234 nya stamaktier i Flerie som fusionsvederlag. Genom emissionen ökar Fleries aktiekapital med 5 867 914,80 kronor. Flerie har således ett totalt aktiekapital om 196 602 859,20 kronor fördelat på totalt 89 364 936 aktier, varav samtliga utgörs av stamaktier. De aktieägare som är upptagna i Biosergens aktiebok per avstämningsdagen den 26 oktober 2026 kommer att erhålla fusionsvederlag. För trettioen (31) aktier i Biosergen erhålls en (1) ny stamaktie i Flerie. Inga åtgärder kommer att erfordras av Biosergens aktieägare för att erhålla fusionsvederlaget. Biosergens aktieägare beräknas erhålla aktier i Flerie dvs. fusionsvederlaget omkring den 28 oktober 2026. Handel i Fleries aktie sker som vanligt och kommer inte att påverkas av fusionsprocessen. Vi investerar globalt i bolag inom produktutveckling och kommersiell tillväxt, tillsammans med andra ledande investerare, och med fokus på svårtillgängliga privata bolag. Fleries aktiva ägarmodell, breda nätverk och resurser används för att stödja och accelerera utvecklingen i bolagens projekt, vilket skapar värde för aktieägarna. Flerie AB:s stamaktie är noterad på Nasdaq Stockholm med ticker FLERIE. För ytterligare information se www.flerie.com (http://www.flerie.com/). The Swedish Companies Registration Office (Sw. Bolagsverket) has granted permission to Flerie AB (publ) (“Flerie”) to carry out the merger plan concerning the merger between Flerie and Biosergen AB (“Biosergen”). It is anticipated that the Swedish Companies Registration Office will register the merger on 23 October 2026. Upon registration of the merger, Biosergen will be dissolved, and all of its assets and liabilities will transfer to Flerie. Following completion of the merger, Biosergen’s business operations will be contributed to a newly formed subsidiary of Flerie Invest AB, which is a wholly owned subsidiary of Flerie. As a result of the approval granted by the Swedish Companies Registration Office and the forthcoming registration of the merger, Biosergen will be delisted from Nasdaq First North Growth Market. The last day of trading in Biosergen’s shares on Nasdaq First North Growth Market is expected to be 22 October 2026. The shareholders listed in Biosergen’s share ledger as of the record date 26 October 2026 will receive merger consideration. For every thirty-one (31) shares held in Biosergen, shareholders will receive one (1) newly issued ordinary share in Flerie. No actions will be required from Biosergen’s shareholders in order to receive the merger consideration. Biosergen’s shareholders are expected to receive these new shares, i.e. the merger consideration, on or about 28 October 2026. Trading in Flerie shares will proceed as normal and will not be affected by the merger process. events.text: The period in brief * Net asset value was SEK 3,113 million (3,918) and net asset value per share was SEK 35.91 (50.58 on 30 September 2025). Change in fair value of shares in portfolio companies in the quarter was SEK -249 million (-124), equivalent to -8.7 per cent (-4.0). * Net profit/loss amounted to SEK -281 million (-138). * Earnings per share before and after dilution amounted to SEK -3.24 (-1.78). Significant events during the quarter * The Extraordinary General Meeting of Flerie approved the merger plan between Flerie and Biosergen.
